newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys one 0.25-pct gas oil cargo for mid Nov.
newsitem.headline: India buys one 0.25-pct gas oil cargo for mid Nov.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought by tender one 45,000-tonne cargo of 0.25-percent sulphur gas oil at $2.55 per barrel above MidEast quotes, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Kandla, traders said on Monday.
The cargo was purchased from Swiss trader Glencore and is for November 16-20 delivery to the Indian west coast port.
IOC had originally tendered for two cargoes, the other for November 6-10 delivery.
Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) made a low offer of $2.48 a barrel premium to MidEast quotes, c-and-f Kandla, but was not awarded, traders said.
In its last tender for October 21-25 delivery, IOC bought one 45,000-tonne cargo of 0.25-percent sulphur gas oil from Dutch trader Vitol at $2.50 above MidEast quotes, c-and-f Kandla.
